scenarios.title: The named evidence-age boundary remains valid

gherkin.given: the behavior policy sets maximumEvidenceAgeDays to 100 times 365 plus 25
gherkin.then: the boundary policy and the committed 56-day policy are accepted, while a non-finite value retains the existing non-finite-policy refusal before semantic bound validation

obligations.requiredProof: Production validatePolicy assertions accept 36525 and the shipped 56-day policy while preserving non-finite refusal precedence.
An artifact assertion reads the committed policy and proves maximumEvidenceAgeDays remains exactly 56.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Changing maximumEvidenceAgeDays from 36525 to 36526 must change validatePolicy from accepted to the exact behavior refusal.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-006: maximumEvidenceAgeDays accepts the named 100-year boundary

expectedAssertions: the committed policy remains 56 and is accepted
non-finite input retains the non-finite-policy refusal before semantic validation

scenarios.title: One day above the evidence-age boundary is refused

gherkin.given: the behavior policy sets maximumEvidenceAgeDays one day above the named maximum
gherkin.then: it returns P008-CONFIG invalid-policy for behavior without clamping or echoing the value

obligations.requiredProof: A production validatePolicy assertion transforms the one-over input into the exact frozen PortfolioError/v1 envelope.
The named negative path returns P008-CONFIG invalid-policy for behavior with no clamp, echo, recoverable flag, or plausible default.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Removing the upper-bound predicate must make the 36526 policy accepted instead of returning the exact refusal.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-006: maximumEvidenceAgeDays refuses one day above the named boundary

expectedAssertions: code reason field valueEchoed and recoverable match the frozen config refusal

scenarios.title: An overflowing window is refused before Date derivation

gherkin.given: a valid workspace and an evidence-age window known to exceed the ECMAScript TimeClip range
gherkin.when: deriveInterestSignals is called with that policy
gherkin.then: validation returns P008-CONFIG invalid-policy for behavior and no RangeError escapes

obligations.requiredProof: A production deriveInterestSignals assertion returns the validation failure before workspace validation or Date formatting.
A fixture proven to exceed TimeClip returns the exact config refusal and no RangeError escapes.

testMechanism.negativeControl: The huge finite fixture must overflow direct Date formatting, while removing the policy bound must expose acceptance or RangeError instead of the returned refusal.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-006: an overflowing evidence window is refused before interest derivation

expectedAssertions: the fixture exceeds TimeClip under direct Date formatting
deriveInterestSignals returns P008-CONFIG invalid-policy for behavior
